claims.text: Paradox plans to accelerate the decay of Wade’s timeline after anchor Logan died; replacing Logan is not a valid fix.
Happy rejects Wade’s Avengers application; later Wade is retired and separated from Vanessa.
Wade fails to revive the buried Logan, uses his bones against TVA agents and finds a different Logan who failed his X-Men.
Paradox prunes them to the Void; Cassandra, Xavier’s twin, kills Johnny and they escape Alioth.
Wade admits he cannot promise to change Logan’s history; they fight in a car and the resistance finds them.
Laura, Blade, Elektra and Gambit help attack Cassandra; a helmet blocks her powers and Pyro betrays her for Paradox.
They save Cassandra; she opens their way home, learns about the machine and follows to destroy timelines.
The Deadpool variants kill Nicepool; Peter distracts the variants after Wade and Logan fight them.
Wade first tries the lethal power bridge alone; Logan joins him and the two overload it, kill Cassandra and survive together, stabilizing the timeline.
B-15 arrests Paradox; Logan stays with Wade, Laura is rescued and Wade reconnects with Vanessa without rewriting Logan’s past.

notes: Deadpool & Wolverine (2024), MCU film; this Logan is a variant, not the resurrected Logan from the grave. Reviewed publisher/archival metadata and compared bounded secondary plot accounts.
